ukberi-tibyan:1-1.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى (١)).
The words of the Exalted (سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ): it is said that the word «اسْمَ» is redundant (zāʾida).
It is also said that in the speech there is an omission of a muḍāf (first term of a genitive construct), i.e. «سَبِّحْ مُسَمَّى رَبِّكَ» (glorify the One named "your Lord"); Abū ʿAlī mentioned both of these in Kitāb al-Shiʿr.
It is also said that it is according to its apparent sense, i.e. keep His name exalted above debasement and lying when you swear by it.

ukberi-tibyan:16-16.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا (١٦)).
(تُؤْثِرُونَ) is read with yāʾ, as the third person, and with tāʾ, as address; i.e. say that to them.

ukberi-tibyan:5-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَى (٥)).
The words of the Exalted (أَحْوَى): it is said that it is a naʿt (adjective) for «غُثَاءً».
It is also said that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الْمَرْعَى» (the pasture); i.e. He brought forth the pasture green, then turned it into stubble; so part of the ṣila (relative clause) was placed first.

ukberi-tibyan:6-6.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسَى (٦)).
The words of the Exalted (فَلَا تَنْسَى): «لَا» is negating, i.e. «فَمَا تَنْسَى» (so you will not forget).
It is also said that it is for prohibition, and it did not make [the verb] jussive (majzūm) for the sake of agreement with the verse-endings.
It is also said that the alif arises from the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the fatḥa.
